Not Humanitarian: an everyday scene unrelated to disaster impacts or relief
a personal portrait or entertainment image without visible crisis information
an advertisement unrelated to humanitarian assistance
Other Relevant Information: a map showing a storm path or an affected geographical area
a weather chart or an official disaster warning graphic
a wide view of a hazard without a specific damaged object or victim
Rescue/Volunteering/Donation: rescue workers helping people reach safety
volunteers distributing food, water, or emergency supplies
a donation appeal or an organized relief collection
Infrastructure/Utility Damage: collapsed buildings or broken walls surrounded by rubble
damaged roads, bridges, or power lines
houses or public facilities visibly damaged by flooding or fire
Affected Individuals: displaced families carrying belongings away from their homes
survivors staying in a temporary shelter
people stranded or waiting for assistance in a disaster area
Vehicle Damage: cars or buses submerged in floodwater
overturned vehicles or wrecked boats after a disaster
Injured or Dead People: injured people receiving emergency medical treatment
covered bodies or visibly deceased victims in a disaster setting
Missing or Found People: a missing person notice with a portrait and contact information
a list of people reported missing or located
a public announcement that a previously missing person has been found
